title: Top 275 PDF: Words 226 to 250
subtitle: Abeyance to Sardonic (SSC CGL 2026 Digital Notes)

words.hindi: कुछ समय के लिए रोक / ठहराव
words.meaning: A state of temporary disuse or suspension.
words.example: The construction project was held in abeyance due to lack of funds.

words.meaning: Approach and address someone boldly or aggressively.
words.example: Reporters tried to accost the minister outside the parliament.

words.meaning: Relating to or characterized by reversion to something ancient or ancestral.
words.example: Fear of the dark is considered an atavistic human instinct.

words.meaning: Support or strengthen; prop up.
words.example: Daily mock tests will bolster your confidence for the exam.

words.meaning: Raise a sensitive or difficult subject for discussion.
words.example: He hesitated to broach the topic of salary hike with his boss.

words.meaning: The final part of a play, movie, or narrative in which the strands of the plot are drawn together.
words.example: The thriller novel had an unexpected and gripping denouement.

words.hindi: अलग-अलग स्रोतों से चुनने वाला / विविध
words.meaning: Deriving ideas, style, or taste from a broad and diverse range of sources.
words.example: The library has an eclectic collection of books on every subject.

words.meaning: Ridiculously old-fashioned; belonging to the time before the biblical flood.
words.example: The office replaced its antediluvian computers with new laptops.

words.meaning: Beginning to grow or increase rapidly; flourishing.
words.example: India has a burgeoning digital startup ecosystem.

words.meaning: In a very poor condition as a result of disuse and neglect.
words.example: The old factory stood derelict at the edge of the town.

words.hindi: गुस्से से भरा लंबा भाषण / कड़ी निंदा
words.meaning: A forceful and bitter verbal attack against someone or something.
words.example: The critic launched into a long diatribe against the policy.

words.hindi: तुरंत ध्यान माँगने वाला / अत्यंत ज़रूरी
words.meaning: Pressing; demanding immediate action or attention.
words.example: The hospital staff handled the exigent situation with speed.

words.meaning: Pompous or extravagant in language, style, or manner, especially in a way that is intended to impress.
words.example: His speech was full of grandiloquent phrases but lacked substance.

words.hindi: जिसे टाला न जा सके / अटल
words.meaning: Unable to be resisted or avoided; inescapable.
words.example: Hard work leads to the ineluctable result of improvement.

words.meaning: Insulting, abusive, or highly critical language.
words.example: A civilized debate has no place for personal invective.

words.hindi: असहमति जताने वाला / लीक से हटकर चलने वाला
words.meaning: An unorthodox or independent-minded person.
words.example: The dissenter openly challenged the outdated group decision.

words.meaning: A public speech or published text in praise of someone or something.
words.example: The author wrote a glowing panegyric on the national hero.

words.hindi: किसी चीज़ की खास पसंद / झुकाव
words.meaning: A strong or habitual liking for something or tendency to do something.
words.example: She has a penchant for solving complex reasoning puzzles.

words.hindi: मन में पुरानी दुश्मनी या कड़वाहट रखने वाला
words.meaning: Characterized by bitterness or resentment.
words.example: After months of rancorous debate, the two sides finally signed a deal.

words.hindi: अनैतिक और गिरा हुआ व्यवहार / नीचता
words.meaning: Depraved or wicked behavior or character.
words.example: The employee was dismissed on grounds of moral turpitude.

words.hindi: खुशामद से मन जीतने वाला / चिकनी-चुपड़ी बातें करने वाला
words.meaning: Excessively or ingratiatingly flattering; oily.
words.example: His ingratiating praise was clearly meant to win favor.

words.meaning: Attractive or appealing in appearance or character.
words.example: The child greeted the guests with a winsome smile.

words.hindi: आदेशात्मक / जिसमें इनकार की गुंजाइश न हो
words.meaning: Insisting on immediate attention or obedience, especially in a brusque and imperious way.
words.example: He issued a peremptory summons for everyone to attend the meeting.

words.hindi: बात जल्दी और सही समझने वाला / कुशाग्र बुद्धि
words.meaning: Having a ready insight into and understanding of things.
words.example: The perspicacious detective noticed the tiny clue immediately.

words.meaning: Grimly mocking or cynical.
words.example: He gave a sardonic smile when he heard the hollow excuse.
